text:
Hi — I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (plus Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Other things I do** — schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

One thing I'm missing: my own name and gender aren't set yet — Diego is just the placeholder. How would you like me to be: what name, and should I speak of myself as neuter (it/they), male or female?

What would you like to start with?
On it: I've written to the staff group thread with my free slots for next week and asked each TA which works. I'll book the meeting and log it once they answer.
